intended_use: Reference data for an informational triage aid. It ranks possible conditions and routes red-flag symptoms to urgent care. It is not a diagnostic tool and has not been clinically validated.

symptoms.name: Flashing lights or zig-zag lines in vision
Weakness or numbness on one side of the body
Numbness around the groin or buttocks
Loss of bladder or bowel control
Pain or pressure around the cheeks, eyes or forehead
Thick yellow or green nasal discharge
Swelling of the throat, lips or tongue
Pain spreading to the arm, jaw or back
Pain in the lower right side of the abdomen
Pain in the upper right side of the abdomen
Sour taste or acid coming up into the mouth
Burning or pain when passing urine
Pain in the side or back, below the ribs
Thin lines or tracks on the skin
Rash that does not fade when a glass is pressed on it

red_flags.label: Severe chest pain, or chest pain with breathlessness, sweating, fainting or pain spreading to the arm, jaw or back
red_flags.rationale: Possible heart attack; every minute without treatment matters.

red_flags.label: Face drooping, one-sided weakness, slurred speech or sudden vision loss
red_flags.rationale: BE-FAST stroke signs; treatment is time-critical.

red_flags.label: Sudden, very severe headache
red_flags.rationale: A sudden worst-ever headache can be a bleed in the brain.

red_flags.label: Confusion, unusual drowsiness or a seizure
red_flags.rationale: Altered consciousness can signal sepsis, meningitis, severe malaria or heat stroke.

red_flags.label: Severe breathlessness or bluish lips or face
red_flags.rationale: Signs of not getting enough oxygen.

red_flags.label: Swelling of the throat, lips or tongue, or hives with breathing problems
red_flags.rationale: Possible anaphylaxis; airway can close quickly.

red_flags.label: Fever with a stiff neck, or a rash that does not fade under a glass
red_flags.rationale: Classic warning signs of meningitis or meningococcal sepsis.

red_flags.label: Vomiting blood, coughing up blood, or black or bloody stool
Fever with bleeding gums or nosebleeds
red_flags.rationale: Mucosal bleeding is a dengue warning sign.

red_flags.label: Severe abdominal pain
red_flags.rationale: Possible appendicitis, perforation or a dengue warning sign.

red_flags.label: Unable to keep fluids down, or passing little or no urine
red_flags.rationale: Severe dehydration; persistent vomiting is also a dengue warning sign.

red_flags.label: Loss of bladder or bowel control, or back pain with numbness around the groin
red_flags.rationale: Possible spinal nerve compression (cauda equina syndrome).
